intro: Ula'elek is a Darkspear troll smith residing in Sen'jin Village along the southern coast of Durotar. Working in tandem with the veteran orc smith Thun'grim Firegaze, he crafts specialized armor for Horde warriors striving to prove their worth. His work combines traditional troll craftsmanship with exotic trophies gathered from across Kalimdor.

p: Ula'elek plies his craft amid the huts and braziers of Sen'jin Village, serving the Darkspear tribe as a skilled armorsmith. In a coastal settlement constantly threatened by nearby hostile quilboar and sea crawlers, keeping working blades and sturdy armor ready is vital to the tribe's survival. However, Ula'elek's renown extends beyond local defense, drawing the attention of seasoned warriors across the Horde.

When young warriors visit Thun'grim Firegaze atop his overlook in the Barrens, the old veteran directs them south toward Sen'jin Village to seek out Ula'elek. Thun'grim trusts the troll smith to fashion Brutal Gauntlets, an imposing piece of battle gear worthy of battle-hardened frontliners. Ula'elek demands rare materials for the task, most notably the swollen, uncloven hooves of the satyrs who leech the forest's magic in northeastern Ashenvale.
